title: Design a bounded sensor pipeline
description: Design a system sampling eight 16-bit channels at 2 kHz and sending batches over a link that can stall for 100 ms. Specify buffering, timestamps, ownership, overload behavior, and observability. Account for metadata and explain which deadlines need measurement.
prompt: Design a system sampling eight 16-bit channels at 2 kHz and sending batches over a link that can stall for 100 ms. Specify buffering, timestamps, ownership, overload behavior, and observability. Account for metadata and explain which deadlines need measurement.
constraints: State assumptions and separate measurements from guarantees.
rubric: Calculate raw throughput and minimum payload buffering for a stated stall window.
Define backpressure or an explicit drop policy and record losses.
Discuss DMA ownership, timestamp rollover, and bounded processing budgets.
follow_ups: What changes when the link stalls indefinitely?
How would you partition work between ISR and task context?
hints: Write down the boundary cases before choosing an implementation.
Use explicit integer widths and keep intermediate values in range.
